fixed.summary: The hotkey cap under the slot is the scene's plate (--scene-plate) in the scene's ink (--scene-ink), the pair every pack sets for text over the scene, so it reads over a bright sky as over a dark floor; under the default style it was muted grey on a translucent cap and all but vanished over the sky.
Its hotkey caps take the scene's plate and ink, as AbilitySlot's do.
